title: Fiscal Year 26 Community Assistance Program - State Support Services Element (CAP-SSSE)
reasoning: CAP-SSSE is a FEMA program that funds state-level technical assistance to communities participating in the National Flood Insurance Program — adjacent to Hohonu's flood monitoring space but focused on floodplain management and compliance rather than sensor/data deployment. Worth tracking as state agencies receiving these funds occasionally procure monitoring infrastructure as a downstream activity.
